Split the knitting kill gate's prior-art condition into two claims and answered both: the domain condition is not met (no tool supplies an intervention sequence for an existing hand-knit), the novelty condition is met (minimum-cost repair planning is prior art), so the algorithmic-advantage claim is abandoned as F009

The knitting planner's algorithmic advantage is disproved as prior art (2007-2026 literature); no knitting tool, paper, repository or patent supplying an intervention sequence for an existing hand-knit structure was found
